comparison.objective: Push a clog through a drain using a rod without kinking it; candidate removes a latched electrical terminal.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated short-stroke pushing and regrasping of a buckling member versus precise blade insertion under a tab and coordinated tensile withdrawal.
comparison.success_condition: Clog travel with no rod coupling beyond the kink limit; candidate requires terminal exit without bypass, crimp separation, housing damage, or neighbor release, though numeric limits are missing.
comparison.reason: Both involve slender objects, but one controls compressive buckling while the other releases a localized latch in tension.
